name: 麦格尼
who: An adult dwarf in his sixties, a heavy-armour general of the dwarf kingdom, about 140 cm but as broad as a doorway, immensely wide shoulders and thick arms. Rust-copper red hair with grey at the temples, swept back under a thin circlet, and a huge rust-copper beard in two thick braids bound with brass rings; a granite brow, deep-set stern eyes of dark brown, a few fine scratches across the cheek, short pointed ears. He stands like a cliff that has decided to stay.
palette: rust copper and dark bronze, deep charcoal-blue shadows, one small ember-orange accent
casual: His off-duty general's coat: a heavy dark charcoal wool coat with a thick brown fur collar, a high closed collar, bronze buttons and bronze-banded cuffs, a broad belt with a plain bronze buckle, thick dark trousers and iron-toed boots. Both thick hands hang at his sides, a stern, steady, patient expression.
private: In his hall after the watch changes: a thick undyed wool tunic with the sleeves pushed up over strong forearms, a leather apron-vest, wool trousers, heavy house boots. He holds a stoneware mug in one hand and a small whetstone in the other. A tired, faintly warm half-smile under the beard.
battle: Full dwarf heavy plate in dark bronze and blackened steel with interlocking diamond-shaped plates, huge layered pauldrons under a fur mantle, a plain studded breastplate. He grips a tall tower shield covered in overlapping dragon-bone scale plates, its lower edge planted on the ground in front of him, one gauntleted hand on its rim; a short broad axe hangs at his belt. Feet wide, shoulders squared, a grim, immovable look.
formal: A general's full dress of the dwarf kingdom: a long deep blue coat with bronze embroidery along the high collar and cuffs, a bronze-clasped dark fur mantle, a wide belt with a heavy ceremonial buckle, his beard braids bound with polished bronze rings, a thin bronze circlet. He stands very straight, a little stiff and gruff in the finery.
art: A heavy low-angle bust, the head bowed a little, the stern eyes looking straight down at the viewer, one thick hand pressed flat against a stone wall at the edge of the frame as if feeling it for cracks. A faint grim, steady expression. Hard-edged ember-orange rim light from the side, the shadow of the dragon-bone shield's edge falling across half his face. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust and sparks. He wears the dark bronze plate with the fur mantle.

name: 蕾雅
who: A woman of about thirty, the second guildmaster of the adventurers' guild, 168 cm, slim, light and wiry with a quiet toughness. Short wind-tousled silvery pale-gold hair swept to one side with a few strands over the forehead and a small braid pinned back, pale ice-blue eyes with a calm, tired, steady look, a gentle, clear face. She looks like someone who counts the exits first and the people second.
palette: silver-white and pale gold, deep midnight-blue shadows, one small pale-blue accent
casual: Her travelling guild coat: a long midnight-blue cloak with a high white collar clasped by a small star brooch, over a high-collared white blouse and a fitted dark blue vest, a pale blue lining; dozens of small mismatched cloth badges sewn along the cloak's inner edge, thin silver chains across the chest, dark trousers and sturdy boots. One hand rests on her collar, a calm, kind, watchful expression.
private: At the guild's upper room after hours: a loose cream wool sweater with a high neck, long dark trousers, soft slippers, her hair pulled back with a plain clip. She holds a ladle and a thin recipe booklet, as if a stew had just gone slightly wrong. A tired, warm, rueful smile.
battle: Ready for a rescue in the deep levels: a fitted dark blue field coat with reinforced shoulders, silver-studded steel gauntlets on both hands, a short plated cape clasped with a silver compass-star, dark leggings, high buckled boots, a coil of rescue rope across her chest and a small lantern at her hip. A slim straight sword is sheathed at her side. She stands tall, one gauntleted hand raised palm-out as if signalling the line to retreat; a focused, steady expression.
formal: A guildmaster's formal robes: a long white coat-dress with deep blue facings and silver piping, a high collar, a short blue mantle clasped with a silver star, white gloves, polished low boots, her hair neatly pinned with a silver star ornament. She holds a rolled name-list in one hand. A composed, faintly weary dignity.
art: A close bust with the head tilted slightly, looking back at the viewer with soft tired eyes and a small gentle smile, one gauntleted hand resting against her collar. A cold pale-blue doorway glow behind her, a hard-edged shadow of a lantern frame falling across one side of her face. Foreground blur: dangling badges and a swinging rope end. She wears the midnight-blue guild coat with the white collar.

name: 奥尔文
who: A man of about thirty-five, a deep-dungeon cartographer, 184 cm, tall and spare, with long slender fingers more at ease on a pen than a sword. Messy dark brown-black hair falling over the brow with a few silvered strands, steel-grey eyes under heavy lids reddened from lack of sleep, a thin sleepless face; a gear-like brass monocle with a pale glass lens over one eye hung with fine chains. He has the stillness of someone who will not draw a line he is not sure of.
palette: deep midnight indigo and antique gold, soft lamp amber, one small starlight-blue accent
casual: A mapmaker's long coat: a high-collared indigo coat with thin gold piping, a dark shirt closed to the throat, a charcoal waistcoat, black gloves, a wide belt with pen cases and a chart tube, dark trousers and boots; folded star charts sewn into the inside of the coat. He holds a fine steel drawing pen in one hand. A calm, tired, exact expression.
private: In the survey office after midnight: a plain dark wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a loose indigo scarf, dark trousers, worn slippers, the monocle pushed up onto his forehead. He holds a cooling cup of tea and a half-finished chart with a ruler across it. A tired, faintly sheepish expression.
battle: A field-surveyor's expedition gear: a fitted dark indigo coat with reinforced shoulders and a high stiff collar, leather bracers, a bandolier of ink flasks and compass cases, a short travelling cape with gold trim, black gloves, sturdy boots. An unrolled star chart floats unfurled beside his raised hand, held by a ring of thin golden lines. A slim sword stays sheathed. A focused, steady stance, eyes on the walls.
formal: A formal black-and-indigo court coat with gold thread tracing a faint constellation along the high collar and cuffs, a white shirt front, a long indigo mantle clasped with a small brass sextant brooch, polished black gloves, the monocle on its chain. He carries a slim tied scroll under one arm. A precise, courteous, slightly uneasy bearing.
art: A close bust looking down at an unseen map, only the eyes lifting to meet the viewer, one gloved hand holding the pen point just above a glowing line of star-dots on parchment in the lower frame. A calm focused expression. Warm lamp light from one side, the hard-edged shadow of the gear monocle's chains falling across his cheek. Foreground blur: drifting gold star-dots and fine chain links. He wears the high-collared indigo coat.

name: 米蕾卡
who: A woman of about twenty-eight, a mender of torn echoes, 163 cm, slight, with a tired but bright look. Long loosely curled honey-gold hair with darker amber roots, pinned with a dark lace headband and a few needles tipped with tiny starlight beads, warm amber eyes with a soft, weary, kind gaze, a fine delicate face with faint shadows beneath the eyes.
palette: honey gold and deep plum-black, warm candlelight, one small starlight-violet accent
casual: Her mender's coat: a loose dark plum-black overcoat with a high collar and long wide sleeves, a high-necked ivory blouse buttoned to the throat beneath, a belt hung with thread spools in plum and blue and a small needle roll, black lace fingerless gloves marked with fine burn lines, a long dark skirt to the ankles, low boots. One hand rests against her cheek, a gentle, tired, secretly amused expression.
private: Back in her workroom: a soft cream knitted cardigan buttoned up over a plain high-necked blouse, a long brown skirt, thick socks, her hair in a loose side braid, a half-sewn cloth bird on the windowsill. She holds a needle and a spool of blue thread. A small, sleepy, unguarded smile.
battle: Ready to mend a tear in the world: a fitted plum-black field coat with a high collar and reinforced sleeves, a thick leather harness for spools, shears and a pin cushion, long black gloves, a short travelling cape, dark leggings and strong boots. A long glowing violet thread runs from her raised hand, pulling the edges of a cracked tear in the air together. A steady, concentrated stance, eyes narrowed.
formal: A guild's evening dress: a long high-necked plum velvet gown with long sleeves and fine gold stitching at the collar and cuffs, a short black lace cape with a star-bead clasp, black gloves, her hair pinned up neatly with the needle pins. She keeps one finger on a tiny silver thimble on the other hand. A quiet, composed, slightly tired dignity.
art: A close bust, her head resting on one hand, looking at the viewer from under half-lowered lashes with a soft knowing smile, the other hand holding a needle with a thread of faint light. Warm candlelight from one side, the hard-edged shadow of hanging threads falling across half her face. Foreground blur: drifting loose threads and tiny starlit beads. She wears the high-collared plum-black coat with the thread spools at the shoulder.

name: 阿卡夏
who: A tiefling woman of about thirty, a shadow assassin, 166 cm, slim and quick, with a silent step. Long black hair with a violet sheen worn down under a hood, deep violet eyes like a faint light at the edge of the void, a cool, calm, narrow face with a thin gold chain across the brow; two small curved dark horns just visible beneath the hood, a thin tail curling behind her. She seems to move along a wall like a shadow brushed across it.
palette: deep black-violet and dusky amethyst, cold night blue, one small gold accent
casual: Her night-work garb: a long hooded dark violet cloak, a close-fitting dark leather jerkin with a high stiff collar over a black high-necked shirt, long sleeves with leather bracers, black gloves, dark trousers and soft-soled boots, amethyst drops hanging from the gold chain at her brow, a slim knife at the belt. One hand lifts a folded paper between two fingers, a cool, unreadable look.
private: At her hideout above a bakery: a loose dark grey wool tunic with a high neck and long sleeves over slim dark trousers, no hood, her long hair tied back loosely, bare of jewellery but one small gold ring. She holds a small ginger cat in the crook of one arm. A rare, faint, private smile.
battle: On a job: a close dark violet hooded cloak over fitted black leather armour with a high collar, slim shoulder plates, bracers, gloves and boots, no skin showing at the neck or arms, a pair of slim curved daggers at the hips, one drawn and held low. She stands half-turned and low, ready to slip away into the dark; a hard, calm, focused gaze.
formal: A masked-ball dress for infiltrating a banquet: a long high-necked black and deep violet gown with long sleeves, a lace overlay at the collar and cuffs, a short sheer violet veil from the hair, amethyst drop earrings, black gloves, dark shoes; a small fan folded in one hand. She stands poised, a faint polite smile, eyes watching the room.
art: A close bust, the hood half down, the head tilted so only one violet eye is fully visible, a gloved finger lifting a small gold-chained key near her cheek. A cool, amused, unreadable expression. A thin cold moonless-night rim light, the hard-edged shadow of a window grille across half her face. Foreground blur: drifting dark violet silk and scraps of paper. She wears the hooded violet cloak and high-collared jerkin.

name: 格拉德
who: A half-orc man of about forty, a former blood-oath fighter now seeking redemption, 205 cm, huge and heavy with broad shoulders and thick forearms. Grey-green skin, short messy dark brown hair going grey at the temples, a short stubble beard, brown eyes with a calm, guarded, weary gaze, short tusks with one broken, a thin scar across one cheek, pointed ears with a small iron ring. He sits and stands in a way that makes sure his hands are always visible.
palette: ash grey and dark iron, dull ember red, one small faded-bandage cream accent
casual: His everyday clothes: a plain dark grey wool jerkin with a high collar over a long-sleeved shirt, wide leather bracers, long strips of burnt cloth wrapped around both fists, a faded dark red scarf, heavy trousers and worn boots, a wide plain belt. Both big hands visible, open at his sides, a calm, guarded, patient expression.
private: At a small rented room: a loose undyed wool shirt buttoned to the throat with the sleeves rolled, dark trousers, worn slippers, his fist wraps hung to dry on a chair. He holds a small child-sized boot and a needle with thread, mending its sole. A quiet, tired, gentle half-smile.
battle: Ready for a fight: studded dark leather harness and a heavy shoulder pauldron on the left over a high-collared dark mail shirt with long sleeves, thick steel-banded forearm guards over the burnt fist wraps, a short tattered dark red cloak, heavy plated boots. Both fists up in front of him in a low, grounded boxing stance, knees bent. A grim, steady, controlled look.
formal: A fighters' court coat: a long dark charcoal coat with a high collar and plain iron buttons, a clean grey shirt, a broad dark red sash, polished black boots, the fist wraps replaced by plain black gloves, a small iron brooch on the chest. He stands a little stiffly, hands clasped in front, a careful, humble expression.
art: A close bust looking slightly up from under his brow, a grim half-smile with a broken tusk showing, one wrapped fist raised near his chin. Warm ember-red light from below left, the hard-edged shadow of a heavy chain falling across half his face. Foreground blur: drifting ash flakes and scraps of burnt cloth. He wears the dark grey jerkin with the dark red scarf.

name: 索菲亚
who: A woman of about thirty, a wandering freelance mercenary, 175 cm, tall and sturdy with long-distance runner's legs. Long wavy red-brown hair with a bit of grass seed caught in it, falling free with a worn red bandana tied over the top; warm amber-brown eyes, bright and wary, a faint thin scar across one cheekbone, a quick sharp grin. She laughs like someone who has already priced the whole room.
palette: rust red and worn leather brown, warm sun-gold, one small cream accent
casual: Her mercenary clothes: a worn dark brown leather jerkin with a high collar over a long-sleeved cream shirt buttoned to the throat, a patched red-brown cloak with a faded company badge on the shoulder, a red neck scarf, a broad belt with pouches, brown trousers and tall boots, small gold drops in her ears. A treasure chest tucked under one arm. A bright, confident, wary grin.
private: At a tavern corner after pay-day: a loose cream wool sweater with a high round neck and long sleeves, a long brown skirt, soft boots, her hair in a loose braid, the red bandana tied around her wrist. She holds a tin mug and a folded paper contract. A relaxed, wry smile.
battle: Field gear: a fitted dark brown leather cuirass over a long-sleeved cream shirt with a high laced collar, one large dented steel pauldron, leather bracers, a red-brown cloak torn at the hem, tall boots and leather gloves. She grips a rough iron-bound pole, whatever was to hand, in both hands, planted beside her, its end glowing faintly. A low, balanced, laughing stance.
formal: A hired-captain's dress for a client's dinner: a long dark red tailored coat-dress with a high collar and plain brass buttons, a clean white shirt collar showing, a dark leather belt, polished boots, a company badge pinned at the chest, her hair neatly braided back. She keeps one thumb hooked in her belt. A cheerful, slightly impatient look.
art: A close bust, leaning her cheek on her fist, looking at the viewer with a teasing sidelong grin, the other hand tapping the lid of a worn wooden chest. Bright warm sun from behind, the hard-edged shadow of a tattered banner falling across half her face. Foreground blur: drifting dry grass seed and stray cloth scraps. She wears the dark brown jerkin with the red-brown cloak.

name: 莫里斯
who: An old man of about seventy, a retired scholar of ancient devices, 172 cm, thin with a slight stoop, who straightens to his full height when he looks at the stars. Long loose white hair with a few strands falling over the brow and a long white beard braided at the end, thin round glasses over pale grey eyes, a gentle, sharp, absent-minded face lined with years of late nights, a ring on several fingers.
palette: pale silver-white and old gold, deep midnight blue, one small starlight accent
casual: His scholar's robes: a long deep midnight-blue robe with a high collar, pale grey-white wide sleeves, a simple silver chain and a small astrolabe-shaped clasp at the shoulder, a wide cloth belt stuffed with notebooks and pens, dark trousers and soft boots; pockets bulging with scraps of notes. One hand rests on a dark walking cane. A mild, thoughtful, faintly distracted expression.
private: In his study on a cloudy day: a faded dark wool dressing gown over a plain white shirt, loose trousers, worn felt slippers, spectacles pushed up onto his hair. He holds a half-eaten biscuit in one hand and pats his pockets for a lost pen with the other. A sheepish, soft smile.
battle: A field-expedition robe for dismantling a runaway device: a long midnight-blue travelling coat with reinforced shoulders, a short silver-trimmed cape, leather bracers, a belt hung with small tools and brass lenses, sturdy boots. One hand raised in front of him with fingers spread, orbiting rings of faint gold glyphs turning around it; the cane in the other hand. A calm, concentrated stance, eyes narrowed behind the glasses.
formal: A scholar's ceremonial robe: a long deep blue velvet robe with gold-thread constellations along the hem and cuffs, a pale silver mantle with a round astrolabe clasp, a tall high collar, white gloves, his hair and beard neatly combed. He holds a slim ceremonial staff topped by a small brass sphere. A dignified, slightly bewildered look at the honour.
art: A close bust, the chin resting on one ring-covered hand, the head tilted up toward a sky out of frame, eyes lifting slowly to the viewer with a gentle, curious, tired smile. Soft gold light from a great ring behind him, the hard-edged shadow of a brass astrolabe's rim falling across half his face and beard. Foreground blur: drifting gold star-dots and fine chain links. He wears the midnight-blue robe with the astrolabe clasp.

name: 诺维安
who: A young man of about twenty-six, a lock-breaker and key-archivist, 176 cm, lean and quick, he crouches before a mechanism like a cat over a bone. Tousled ash-grey brown hair falling over the brow, a thin pair of round-framed glasses with a fine chain at one side, sharp pale grey eyes under a lowered brow, a clean, quiet, intent face. Black gloves with heat-warm key shards set at the fingertips.
palette: charcoal black and aged gold, deep wine-brown shadows, one small ember-red accent
casual: His archivist's coat: a long black coat with a tall stiff collar and thin gold piping, a white shirt collar and dark waistcoat with a row of small buckles, a round gear-shaped brass badge on one shoulder, black gloves, dark trousers and boots; a pack bulging with old locks and failed sketches. He holds a long dark cane with a curved bone-like handle in one hand. A calm, attentive, faintly smug look.
private: At the key archive after closing: a loose dark grey knit sweater with a high round neck over a white shirt collar, dark trousers, worn slippers, the glasses pushed up into his hair, his gloves off with ink-stained fingers. He holds a small brass padlock and a thin pick, turning it by ear. A sleepy, absorbed half-smile.
battle: On a tower-floor expedition: a fitted black field coat with a high collar and reinforced shoulders, leather bracers, black gloves with glowing fingertip shards, a bandolier of small lock picks and tool cases, dark trousers and soft-soled boots. One hand holds out a small ornate glowing ember-red key before him; the other holds the cane lowered. A crouching, ready stance, eyes narrowed behind the glasses.
formal: An archive's evening coat: a long black-and-gold frock coat with a high collar, a white shirt front with a dark ribbon tie, a small ember-red gem brooch, polished black gloves, his hair brushed back, the glasses on their fine chain. A slim brass key hangs on a chain at the chest. A cool, polite, slightly bored composure.
art: A close bust, the head lowered, looking up at the viewer over the rim of his glasses with a quiet, intent, faintly smug look, one gloved hand lifting a small glowing ember-red key before his chest. A dim ember-red light from the key on the lower half of his face, a hard-edged shadow of a lock's grille across his eyes. Foreground blur: drifting tiny brass cog wheels and chain links. He wears the tall-collared black coat.

name: 梅莉娅
who: A woman of about thirty, an alchemist who treats grey-tide contamination, 170 cm, slim and tired with grey stains on her wrists. Long loose near-black hair with a silver-blue gloss and a thin braid at one temple, pale grey-blue eyes with faint violet shadow beneath them, a pale, cold, composed face. She looks like a poison flower still in bloom, and she knows it.
palette: pale silver-grey and midnight blue, deep violet shadows, one small glass-blue accent
casual: Her apothecary's coat: a long pale grey-silver coat with a stiff high collar edged with thin silver, a dark indigo high-necked shirt, a leather belt and bandolier hung with corked glass vials, small silver star-shaped clasps, dark gloves, long dark trousers and boots; the vials chime softly under the hem. One hand rests against the vial rack at her chest, a cool, tired, steady look.
private: In her dispensary after the last patient: a soft dark blue knitted cardigan buttoned over a plain high-necked grey blouse, a long dark skirt, thick socks, her hair in a loose low braid, the vial belt hung on the door. She holds a steaming cup of herb tea and a small labelled bottle. A quiet, worn, faintly kind half-smile.
battle: Field-alchemist gear: a fitted dark silver-grey field coat with reinforced shoulders and a high collar, a heavy bandolier of glowing blue and violet vials, leather gloves, a short travelling cape, dark leggings and boots, a small shielded glass lantern at the belt. One hand throws a small flask that bursts into a cloud of cool blue light; the other is held ready at her chest. A sharp, focused, composed stance.
formal: A medical guild's formal robe: a long pale silver-grey gown-coat with a high collar, long sleeves and dark blue velvet cuffs, a short blue mantle with a silver star clasp, a single glass vial hung at the throat on a chain, dark gloves, her hair pinned back neatly. A calm, formal, faintly weary dignity.
art: A close bust, the head slightly lowered, looking at the viewer with pale cool eyes, the faintest hint of a rueful smile, a small glowing blue vial held between two gloved fingers near her cheek. Cool glass-blue light from the vial on one side, the hard-edged shadow of a bottle rack falling over half her face. Foreground blur: drifting glass-blue droplets and blurred vials. She wears the pale grey-silver coat with the high collar.

name: 巴罗
who: An adult halfling man of about thirty-five, a travelling merchant, about 118 cm, short, sturdy and quick on his feet; a grown man with an adult face and adult proportions, only small. Curly tousled warm brown hair pressed into spikes by a travelling hat, warm hazel-brown eyes, a sly, friendly, weathered face with a small smile and a few fine laugh lines, a small gold hoop in one ear. He looks like he could carry a house on his back, and does.
palette: warm leather brown and brick red, lantern amber, one small brass accent
casual: His travelling merchant's clothes: a wide brown leather jerkin with a high collar over a long-sleeved cream shirt, a long dark red neck scarf with a tassel, crossed leather straps across the chest, a broad belt hung with a coin purse and a ledger book, brown trousers and brass-toed, polished iron-capped boots, a rolled blanket on his shoulder. His thumbs hooked in the straps, a bright, cheerful, shrewd smile.
private: At an inn's back table after the market closes: a soft undyed wool sweater with a round collar and sleeves rolled, brown corduroy-like trousers, thick wool socks and slippers, his hat on the table. He holds a half-eaten bun in one hand and a pencil in the other, counting coins into stacks. A warm, tired, happy smile.
battle: On a dangerous road: a sturdy brown leather coat with a high collar and shoulder guards, thick leather bracers, a wide belt of pouches, iron-capped boots, a heavy folded travelling pack-crate strapped to his back, taller than he is, bristling with salt bags, water flasks and bandage rolls. He pulls its strap with one hand and holds up a small round iron shield with the other. A determined, stubborn forward-leaning stance, eyes bright.
formal: A guild merchant's festival clothes: a short dark red velvet coat with a high collar and brass buttons, a white shirt with a neat dark cravat-ribbon, a brass chain and small gold pin across the waistcoat, polished short boots, his curls combed flat and a feathered hat held in one hand. He stands very straight on tiptoe, a proud, slightly self-conscious grin.
art: A close bust slightly from below, the head tilted, a sly, friendly, knowing smile, one hand holding a small cloth sack up to the viewer as if showing the last of his wares. Warm amber lantern light from the side, the hard-edged shadow of the crate straps falling across half his face. Foreground blur: drifting salt crystals and strings of tiny lanterns. He wears the brown leather jerkin and red scarf.

name: 林薇
who: A wood-elf woman who looks about twenty-five, a frost archer of the far north, 168 cm, lean and tight with archer's lines in her arms, long pointed ears. Short chin-length silvery white hair with a green underlayer at the tips, pale ice-blue-green eyes, a very still, cool, delicate face; she stands with no wasted movement, like a figure in the snow fog.
palette: frost white and pale ice blue, soft forest green, one small silver accent
casual: Her northern hunting clothes: a high-necked pale grey-white wool tunic with long sleeves closed to the throat, a green-lined short white fur-collared cloak clasped with a small ice-blue gem, leather bracers, a quiver strap across the chest, grey leggings under a short split skirt, fur-lined boots, a thin silver circlet of leaves. One hand rests on the quiver strap, a calm, cool, silent look.
private: In a small snow-lodge: a thick cream knitted jumper with a high neck, long soft pale grey skirt over wool leggings, fur slippers, her hair loose, the circlet left on the shelf. She holds a mug of warm milk and a small carved wooden bird. A barely-there, gentle smile.
battle: Ready for the long shot: a fitted pale grey-white hunter's coat with a high collar, a white fur mantle with a green lining, leather bracers and gloves, tall fur-lined boots, a quiver of ice-feathered arrows on her back. She holds a tall pale ice-blue longbow upright in one hand, an arrow nocked and half-drawn along it, her eyes fixed on a far point. A still, balanced, silent stance.
formal: A wood-elf court dress: a long high-necked white and soft green gown with long sleeves and thin silver leaf embroidery at the collar and cuffs, a short pale fur shoulder mantle with a clasp of ice-blue stones, a silver circlet of leaves on her head, pale slippers. She stands very still with her hands folded. A cool, serene, distant calm.
art: A close bust, looking straight past the viewer with a quiet steady gaze, the head level, a bow's pale string drawn along her cheek and an arrow tip glinting at the edge of the frame. A cold, near-silent expression. Cold white-blue snow light from behind, the hard-edged shadow of a bare branch falling over half her face. Foreground blur: drifting snow crystals and ice-feathers. She wears the white fur-collared cloak and high-necked tunic.

name: 加兰
who: A half-orc man of about thirty-five, a brawler and close-combat teacher, 195 cm, wide shoulders, a thick back, heavy but not clumsy. Grey-green skin, short messy dark brown hair, a short stubble jaw, warm amber-brown eyes, short tusks with one canine chipped at the tip, pointed ears with a small hoop, a broad crooked grin. He stands like a wall that happens to turn on its heels.
palette: moss grey-green and worn leather brown, dull brick red, one small bandage-cream accent
casual: His everyday clothes: a worn dark brown leather jerkin with a high collar over a long-sleeved grey shirt, a frayed brick-red scarf over one shoulder, leather bracers, long strips of old cloth wrapped around both fists, dark trousers and worn boots. Both fists lightly clenched at his sides, a broad, easy, crooked grin.
private: At the training hall after lessons: a soft undyed wool shirt buttoned to the throat with the sleeves rolled, loose trousers, bare-heeled sandals-style slippers, the hand wraps hung to dry on a rail. He holds a chipped clay mug of tea and a bandage roll for a student's hand. A warm, relaxed, faintly teasing smile.
battle: Fight gear: studded dark leather harness over a long-sleeved mail shirt with a high collar, a heavy pauldron on the left shoulder carved with a snarling face, thick banded steel forearm guards over the cloth wraps, a short tattered brick-red cloak, heavy boots. Both fists up in front of him, one glowing with a turning spiral of pale blue light around the knuckles. A low, wide, grounded stance, a fierce crooked grin.
formal: A guild teacher's formal coat: a long dark moss-green coat with a high collar and plain brass buttons, a clean grey shirt, a dark brick-red sash, polished black boots, black gloves instead of wraps, a small badge pinned at the chest, short hair brushed flat. He stands upright with his hands behind his back, a slightly embarrassed, polite grin.
art: A close bust, one wrapped fist tucked under his chin and the other braced forward, a broad crooked grin with a chipped tusk showing, eyes bright and challenging, leaning toward the viewer. Warm gold light from the side, the hard-edged shadow of his own raised fist falling across half his face. Foreground blur: drifting dust and loose strips of bandage. He wears the dark brown jerkin with the red scarf.

name: 瑟芙
who: An adult fairy woman, a dream-walker of about thirty by human reckoning, small at about 105 cm and slight, with adult proportions and an adult face, only tiny. Long loose inky black hair with a deep violet sheen and a faint glimmer at the tips, deep lake-blue eyes with a sleepy, knowing look, a delicate pale face; a pair of translucent dark violet wings with ink-like water marks across the veins and hem. She looks like someone who has just woken from a dream in a black lake.
palette: inky black-violet and pale silver-lilac, deep lake blue, one small silver accent
casual: Her dream-walker's clothes: a high-collared black velvet bodice-coat with long sleeves and a white ruffled jabot at the throat, a long dark violet skirt with a ripple of ink-like patterns, thin silver chains with small blue stones across the chest, black gloves, small dark boots; the wings spread behind her. One hand lifts to brush a strand of hair from her eyes, a quiet, sleepy, watchful look.
private: In her little house by the lake: a loose soft pale lilac nightgown-style dress with a high round collar and long sleeves, a thick grey knitted shawl, bare of jewellery, her hair in a loose single braid, the wings folded close. She holds a small candle in a tin holder and a thin dream-book. A drowsy, gentle smile.
battle: On a descent into a dream: a close fitted black coat-dress with a high ruffled collar and reinforced shoulders, silver-chained bracers, black gloves and knee boots, a short half-cape of dark violet gauze, the wings half-open. A small glowing blue dream-bubble floats in her raised palm and a thin silvery thread runs from it into the dark. A light, poised, hovering stance a hand above the ground, eyes calm.
formal: An evening gown for the great hall of dreamers: a long high-necked deep blue-black velvet gown with long sleeves, fine silver thread tracing ripples at the cuffs and hem, a lace ruff at the throat, a small silver circlet with a blue stone, black gloves, wings hung with tiny silver beads. Her hands are folded in front. A composed, quiet, faintly mysterious expression.
art: A close bust, the head tilted, looking at the viewer from under heavy lashes with a calm, knowing, sleepy smile, her wing's dark membrane curving behind one shoulder, one gloved finger lifting a tiny bubble of blue light. Cold blue-silver light from one side, the hard-edged shadow of a wing's veins falling across half her face. Foreground blur: drifting glowing bubbles and ink-like droplets. She wears the black velvet high-collared coat with the white ruffled jabot.

name: 霍尔特
who: A man of about forty-five, an auditor of the guild's oversight bureau, 172 cm, not big and not strong, with the weariness of someone who finishes every audit. Untidy dark brown hair falling over the brow with a few grey strands, short stubble, an old healed break in the nose, pale grey-blue eyes narrowed into slits when reading, a lean, worn, sharp face. He looks like a failed clerk and works like a hound on a scent.
palette: dark charcoal and aged brass, deep brown shadows, one small tarnished-silver accent
casual: His auditor's clothes: a long dark charcoal coat with a very high stiff collar and a worn shoulder cape, a cream shirt open at the collar and a dark waistcoat, a wide belt hung with a thick black leather-bound ledger, a round brass seal badge at the chest, dark trousers and scuffed boots; the cuffs frayed. One hand holds the ledger closed against his hip. A tired, shrewd, level look.
private: In a small rented room above a stationer's shop: a worn grey wool cardigan buttoned over a plain shirt, dark trousers, slippers with a mended heel, spectacles-free, his hair uncombed. He holds a cup of cold tea and a single receipt up to the lamp. A dry, tired, faintly amused half-smile.
battle: On a pursuit: a fitted dark charcoal field coat with a high stiff collar and shoulder guards, leather bracers and gloves, a short plain cape, a belt with a sealed ledger case, a short sword and a bundle of rolled warrants, sturdy boots. He holds the open ledger in one hand and with the other points down the road at a trail only he can see. A low, forward-leaning, patient stance, eyes narrowed.
formal: A bureau's formal coat: a long black coat with a high collar, plain brass buttons and a thin brass chain across the waistcoat, a white shirt front with a dark tie-ribbon, polished black boots, black gloves, his hair brushed back and the ledger under one arm. He stands precisely, a stiff, dutiful, slightly bored expression.
art: A close bust, the head tilted down and slightly away, his narrowed pale eyes meeting the viewer over a half-opened black ledger held against his chest, a tired, dry, unreadable look. Warm brass lamp light from one side, the hard-edged shadow of a ledger's page edge falling across half his face. Foreground blur: drifting paper scraps and blurred coins. He wears the high-collared dark charcoal coat.

name: 薇赛拉
who: A sea-folk woman of about thirty, a ship's doctor, 178 cm, tall and sturdy with the strength of someone who has lifted many wounded aboard. Short messy blue-black hair with a deep blue sheen and fine salt grains in it, a hair ornament shaped like a small star on one side, deep stormy-blue eyes, a calm, strong face with fine blue-grey gill-lines along both sides of her neck that open slightly in damp air. A folded surgeon's case always rests against her leg.
palette: deep sea blue and salt white, harbour-lantern amber, one small silver accent
casual: Her ship's doctor clothes: a long chalk-white surgeon's coat with a high collar and deep blue facings, over a close dark blue high-necked tunic with a row of silver star buttons, a silver chain with a small round brass instrument at the chest, a wide belt hung with a bottle and a small roll of needles, dark trousers and sea boots. One hand rests on the strap of the surgeon's case, a calm, level, patient look.
private: On deck at dawn after the night watch: a soft pale blue knitted jumper with a high round neck and long sleeves, dark trousers rolled at the ankle, bare of the coat, her hair damp and tousled, the star ornament left off. She holds a tin mug of hot tea in both hands. A tired, warm, half-asleep smile.
battle: Ready for a ship's emergency: a fitted dark blue storm coat with a high collar and reinforced shoulders over a white tunic, leather gloves, a crossed harness holding a surgeon's case at the hip, a short waterproof cape, dark leggings and sea boots. She holds a curved suture needle trailing a thin silver thread in one hand and the open case in the other, her eyes on a wound out of frame. A steady, planted stance as if on a rolling deck.
formal: A sea-folk fleet's dress uniform: a long deep blue coat with a high collar, silver braid at the cuffs and shoulders, a white shirt front, a silver-blue sash across the chest, a small star medal, polished dark boots, her hair brushed back neatly with the star ornament. She stands with her hands folded behind her. A calm, formal, faintly tired dignity.
art: A close bust with the head tilted and chin lifted, looking straight at the viewer with calm, steady stormy-blue eyes and a slight reassuring smile, one hand resting on the strap of the surgeon's case. Warm harbour-lantern amber light from the side, the hard-edged shadow of a ship's rigging falling across half her face and her gill-lines. Foreground blur: drifting sea-salt grains and loose silver thread. She wears the chalk-white surgeon's coat over the dark blue tunic.
